IN THE COMMISSION FOR CONCILIATION, MEDIATION AND ARBITRATION

Case No: GAJB5678-24

In the matter between:

S DUBE Applicant

ACME RETAIL (PTY) LTD Respondent

Commissioner: L Naidoo

Date of award: 2 May 2024

ARBITRATION AWARD

[1] The applicant was dismissed for theft of two cases of cooldrink. The dispute was referred to the CCMA in terms of section 191 of the LRA.

[2] The evidence showed that three other employees caught in the same incident received final written warnings. The respondent gave no explanation for the inconsistency.

[3] Applying the parity principle, the selective discipline of the applicant was not justified.

AWARD

[4] I find that the dismissal of the applicant was substantively unfair.

[5] The respondent is ordered to reinstate the applicant with retrospective effect.
